meta.description: The 6 agent protocols of the installed opencode agent system (protocols/*.md).

protocols.title: Dispatch
protocols.summary: Turn-entry procedure for the delivery seat: the interpreter-first hard gate, the "about to ask" tripwire, and the hand-off into the pipeline. Read first on every turn, before any other tool.

protocols.title: Prompt Pipeline
protocols.summary: Step 0 (Interpret) normalizes the raw prompt into a routing packet; Phase 2 (Reduce) turns it into scope. The two phases every non-trivial prompt passes through.

protocols.title: Orchestrate
protocols.summary: Pre-action thinking process for the orchestrator: Protocol Discovery → Context Refresh → Proposal → Implementation → Verification → Documentation.

protocols.title: Subagent Spec Template
protocols.summary: Canonical shape for subagent definitions and the output_schema bridge (the prose contract for structured returns).

protocols.title: Session Recovery
protocols.summary: Recovery flow for interrupted or STUCK sessions across the delivery → orchestrator → subagent hierarchy.

protocols.title: Broad Investigation Template
protocols.summary: 5-section scaffold for prompts that map, inventory, or audit the repo.

protocol.mechanism: Prose markdown under protocols/, read on demand and interpreted by the agent

skill.mechanism: Strict-text, injected by the runtime with a fixed shape

protocolVsSkill.why: This system ships no skills by design: conventions are protocols/*.md — intentionally prose markdown, not .opencode/skills/, because skills are strict-text and protocols are the preferred mechanism here.
